title: WBS が空くまで待って開く(isWbsReady.bat と同じ: 1 分ごと、誰が開いているか表示、q / Esc で止める)
_doc: 10/20: the operator's isWbsReady.bat as a workflow. Not a day phase (no profile here, so the menu does not list it): run it with the profile on the command line -- ebi.ps1 run workflows\util.waitWbs.json -WorkDir <W> -Profile gfix-recv. -Var everySec=30 to look more often.
